characters.summary: Bill Foster is a brilliant biochemist and former S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who possesses expertise in Pym Particles and quantum mechanics. In combat, he relies on his scientific genius, tactical planning, and the ability to grow to giant size using experimental technology.
weaknesses: Cellular instability from prolonged quantum/size manipulation without stabilization
limitations: Cellular degradation caused by quantum instability
Dependent on specialized technology for size alteration

sources.supports: Bill Foster's history as a scientist, work with Pym particles, and giant-sizing capabilities.

feats.claim: Assisted Ava Starr with her quantum phasing condition and mentored her.
Grew to giant size to block S.H.I.E.L.D. agents and protect Ghost.

notableResults.note: Acted as her caretaker and scientific ally.

conditional.dependsOn: Access to Pym-derived quantum suit or particle regulators

campaignTags.claim: Able to grow to giant height using experimental Pym Particle technology.
Manipulates size using quantum technology derived from Pym research.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his giant form's physical strength compared to Scott Lang.

characters.summary: T'Challa, the King of Wakanda, is a formidable martial artist enhanced by the Heart-Shaped Herb and equipped with advanced vibranium armor. He combines peak physical conditioning, acrobatic prowess, and kinetic-energy absorption tech to overwhelm opponents in close combat.

mechanisms: Vibranium weave armor absorbing kinetic impacts
Enhanced durability and rapid healing from Heart-Shaped Herb

weaknesses: Vulnerability to sonic weapons that disrupt vibranium or sensory equilibrium
mobility: Acrobatic leaping and sprinting enhanced by physical conditioning
limitations: Suit kinetic storage capacity can be overloaded if hit with extreme force
Heart-Shaped Herb connection can be severed in the Ancestral Plane

sources.supports: T'Challa's combat abilities, vibranium suit features, and Heart-Shaped Herb enhancements.

feats.claim: Fought evenly with Captain America in close-quarters combat.
Absorbed explosive impacts and redirected kinetic energy to blast back opponents.

notableResults.note: Defeated in ritual combat at Warrior Falls after being stripped of herb enhancements.
Final rematch using vibranium suit and heart-shaped herb power.

campaignTags.claim: Uses Kimoyo beads, vibranium daggers, and energy dampeners.

unknowns: Full upper limit of vibranium suit's kinetic absorption threshold.

characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe (Hypothetical What If...? / Alternate Scenario)
characters.summary: This version of Black Panther wields the Infinity Gauntlet, granting absolute dominion over space, time, reality, power, mind, and soul. He combines Wakandan tactical discipline with omnipotent cosmic control.
weaknesses: Severe physical toll from wielding the combined Infinity Stones
characters.formDifferences: Adds the Infinity Gauntlet to the standard Black Panther skill set, granting universal reality-warping and cosmic energy manipulation.

sources.supports: Capabilities and universal scope of the Infinity Gauntlet.

unknowns: Specific durability of T'Challa's biological frame against Infinity Stone feedback in live-action canon.

characters.id: mcu:Black Panther|King of the Dead Black Panther
characters.summary: The King of the Dead possesses a direct link to all past Black Panthers and ancestral deities of the Necropolis. He wields mystical energy, spiritual command, and enhanced mystical durability.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to severe spiritual disruption or magical nullification
characters.formDifferences: Grants communion and direct power channeling from the collective ancestors and the realm of the dead.

sources.supports: Context on Wakandan royal lineage and spiritual titles.

unknowns: Full extent of mystical combat applications within strict MCU canon.

characters.summary: Natasha Romanoff is a master spy, martial artist, and expert marksman trained in the Red Room. She utilizes standard firearms, electroshock Widow's Bites, and high-level espionage tactics to neutralize opponents.
limitations: Lacks superhuman durability or healing factors
Relies on ammunition and charged equipment

sources.supports: Natasha Romanoff's combat skills, Widow's Bite usage, and Red Room training.

feats.claim: Defeated numerous Chitauri infantry and secured a portal closure device.
Fought off heavily armed security operatives in hand-to-hand combat.

notableResults.note: Subdued Clint Barton during his mind-controlled state to break Loki's hold.

campaignTags.claim: Uses Widow's Bite gauntlets, grappling hooks, and explosive disks.
Master espionage operative trained in covert infiltration.
Proficient in piloting Quinjets and various aircraft.

unknowns: Exact effectiveness of espionage tactics against cosmic-level beings.

characters.summary: Bruce Banner is a genius physicist whose exposure to gamma radiation causes him to transform into the Hulk when angered or stressed. As Banner, he relies on scientific intellect and tactical gadgetry; as the Hulk, he relies on overwhelming brute physical force.

mechanisms: Impenetrable muscular density and durability (as Hulk)

weaknesses: Vulnerability to mental manipulation or high-tier psychic attacks
limitations: Banner's human form possesses standard human fragility
Hulk transformations can be unpredictable or difficult to trigger on command

sources.supports: Bruce Banner's scientific background, gamma transformation mechanics, and Hulk persona.

feats.claim: Stopped a Leviathan with a single punch.
Tanked heavy artillery and high-explosive ordnance without lasting injury.

notableResults.note: Fought in the Grandmaster's gladiatorial arena; match was interrupted by the Grandmaster.
Defeated quickly in hand-to-hand combat aboard the Statesman.

conditional.dependsOn: Transformation into the Hulk triggered by anger or stress

campaignTags.claim: World-class physicist specializing in gamma radiation and biotechnology.

unknowns: Exact rage ceiling for Hulk's strength scaling in MCU continuity.

characters.summary: Benjamin 'Dex' Poindexter is an FBI agent with exceptional psychopathic marksmanship and spatial calculation abilities. He can turn virtually any ordinary object into a lethal projectile with pinpoint accuracy.
weaknesses: Mental instability and psychological dependency on an anchor
mobility: Peak human athletic movement and agility
limitations: Dependent on having loose objects available to throw

sources.supports: Bullseye's marksmanship, FBI background, and throwing precision.

feats.claim: Ricocheted multiple small objects around corners to strike targets out of line of sight.
Killed multiple targets in rapid succession using office supplies as lethal projectiles.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill in multiple brutal encounters.

unknowns: Performance against opponents with impenetrable armor or energy shields.

characters.summary: Steve Rogers is a super-soldier enhanced by Dr. Erskine's serum, possessing peak human strength, agility, and stamina. He fights with disciplined martial arts, tactical leadership, and a vibranium-alloy shield used for both defense and rebounding ranged attacks.

mechanisms: Vibranium-alloy shield blocking energy and physical strikes

weaknesses: Vulnerability to superior overwhelming brute force or magical/energy attacks bypassing the shield
limitations: Shield coverage is limited by its physical dimensions

sources.supports: Captain America's super-soldier enhancement, shield combat, and physical feats.

feats.claim: Restrained a taking-off helicopter with arm strength alone.
Wielded Mjolnir in combat against Thanos, utilizing lightning and enhanced striking power.

notableResults.note: Fought alongside Bucky Barnes; disabled Tony Stark's armor in close combat.
Overpowered in single combat when Thanos caught his arm.

campaignTags.claim: Trained to pilot military aircraft and Quinjets.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of lifting strength without mechanical leverage.
